name: Controller Tweaks and Remap
summary: Configure controller bindings with an INI, swap shoulders and triggers, enjoy a wider walking range, and use short press Map / long press Game Hub. Requires UE4SS.
thumbnailAltText: Controller Tweaks title over an official in-game screenshot of Coen walking through a town market.
requiredMods: Dawnwalker-compatible UE4SS with TMap and ExecuteInGameThreadWithDelay
fileDescription: Controller stutter fixes: stop completed background checks, coalesce duplicate input events, and recover controls correctly after loading or preset changes. Personal INI settings are preserved. Requires UE4SS.

optionalFiles.name: Original Shoulder Buttons
optionalFiles.description: Preset 1.5.2: same eight bindings; refreshed docs. Requires main 1.4.0+ and UE4SS. MANUAL ONLY: back up ControllerTweaks.ini before applying. Replacement overwrites preferences; see README to preserve other settings. Do not install via Vortex.
